name: Chinese Teacher AI
description: From-zero Mandarin Chinese tutor: pinyin and the 4 tones, hanzi with stroke-order animation, HSK-graded grammar path, vocabulary SRS, tone-pair drills, and a speaking tab with browser speech recognition (ASR). Register-aware conversation practice.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Dashboard: level, HSK goal, streak and stats.

tools.name: get_pronunciation
tools.description: Pinyin, the 4 tones + neutral tone, tone sandhi, initials/finals.

tools.name: get_grammar_path
tools.description: HSK-graded grammar path (measure words, aspect particles, 把/被, topic-comment).

tools.name: get_vocabulary
tools.description: Vocabulary items with pinyin + meaning glosses.

tools.name: submit_srs_review
tools.description: Record an SRS grade and reschedule.

tools.name: get_speaking_phrases
tools.description: Phrases for shadowing; browser ASR scores the attempt.

tools.name: send_conversation_message
tools.description: Register-aware conversation turn that corrects and upgrades the learner's Mandarin.
